task: Configure multiple FreeCAD preferences in ~/.config/FreeCAD/user.cfg: (1) Set the Theme to exactly 'Dark', (2) Ensure auto-save is enabled and set its interval to 180 seconds, (3) Set the User system to 'Imperial from SI (in, in/s^2)' which corresponds to schema index 2.

verification.description: Units schema set to 2 (Imperial from SI)
